# C 在各读法下的排序：逐步读法保持“共享优于以消耗取胜”，在二元定律族中保持节制优于过度汲取；过度汲取者在损失之前有被记入的事件时，失去“没有它更好” / What C ranks under each reading: the stepwise reading keeps “sharing is better than winning by consumption” and, in the two-part family, restraint above overdraw, and loses “better without the overdrawing formation” when that formation has a credited event before the loss

## 主张 Claim

把两次继续作为一个框架的配置、把读法所记入的事件作为实现的主张，比较原则 C 就是这一框架上的 Comparison。对任何只记入活跃事件的读法，没有某个形成的继续扩展有它的继续，仅当读法扣下该形成的每个事件。整段读法（活跃且在该继续中不消耗）下，对支持门控定律族中每个超出更新地汲取的焦点形成，没有它的继续扩展有它的继续，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把前者排得更高。逐步读法（活跃且不侵蚀）下，焦点形成在某步活跃、而该步之后每个所需仍被满足时，这一事件被记入；于是两次继续互不扩展，有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有它的继续。恶性增殖与以消耗取胜都是实例。逐步读法下，以消耗取胜者在损失之前的事件被记入、之后的不被记入，而共享的继续记入每个事件，所以共享仍扩展以消耗取胜。在二元定律族中，两种读法下，每个所需始终被满足的继续（节制）都扩展同一族中过度汲取使维持者失去支持的继续，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把节制排得更高，即使逐步读法记入过度汲取者在损失之前的事件；恶性增殖与同一形成在第一步之后、越过阈值之前停止相比也是如此。所以在二元定律族中，逐步读法下 C 失去与不在场的比较，保留与每步都满足所需的继续的比较。焦点形成没有被记入的事件时（例如第一步就越过支持），逐步读法同样把不在场排得更高（Immediate）；有第三个形成共用条件时，节制者此后的汲取可以侵蚀第三者曾被满足的依存，逐步读法下两次继续互不扩展（ThirdParty）。不用 Lean 公理；C 只作为假设或定义出现。 / Taking two continuations as the configurations of a frame and the events a reading credits as its realized claims, comparison principle C is Comparison on that frame. For any reading that credits only active events, the continuation without a formation extends the continuation with it only if the reading withholds every event of that formation. Under the whole-run reading (active and not consuming in that continuation), for every law of the support-gated family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal, the continuation without it extends the continuation with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher. Under the stepwise reading (active and not undermining), an event of the focal formation is credited when it is active and every need is still met after its step; the two continuations then do not extend each other, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with the formation. Malignant growth and winning by consumption are instances. Under the stepwise reading the winner's events before the loss are credited and those after are not, while sharing credits every event, so sharing still extends winning by consumption. In the two-part family, under both readings a continuation in which every need stays met (restraint) extends a continuation of the family in which overdraw ends the sustaining formation's support, so every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint higher, even though the stepwise reading credits the overdrawing formation's events before the loss; so it is for malignant growth against the same formation stopping after its first step, before the threshold. So in the two-part family the stepwise reading loses the comparison with absence and keeps the comparison with a course that meets every need at every step. When no focal event is credited, as when the first step already crosses support, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher (Immediate); when a third formation shares the condition, a restrained formation's later draw can undermine the third formation's once-met dependence, and under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other (ThirdParty). No Lean axiom is used; C occurs only as a hypothesis or a definition.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- C 是公开的比较前提，本结果不证明它；“没有焦点形成的继续”与 relational-reading-comparison 相同，其水平由同一定律在焦点形成不出现时给出。 / C is a disclosed comparison premise, not proved here; the continuation without the focal formation is the one of relational-reading-comparison, its levels given by the same law when the focal formation does not occur.
- 逐步读法的结论需要焦点形成有一个使每个所需仍被满足的活跃步；支持门控定律族的前提（所需为正、焦点所需不超过维持者所需、起点支持维持者、从某步起汲取超出更新）如 relational-renewal-classification 所设。 / The stepwise conclusion needs an active step of the focal formation after which every need is still met; the premises of the support-gated family (positive need, focal need within the sustaining need, a start supporting the sustaining formation, drawing beyond renewal from some step on) are those of relational-renewal-classification.
- 节制的结论只在二元定律族（焦点形成与维持者）中、对每步都满足所需的停止定律证明；多一个共用条件的形成时它可以不成立（ThirdParty）。 / The restraint conclusion is proved only in the two-part family (the focal and the sustaining formation) and for a stopping law that meets every need at every step; with one more formation sharing the condition it can fail (ThirdParty).

两个排序在逐步读法下分道。若 G0 与 C 共用逐步读法，C 仍把共享排在以消耗取胜之上，却不再把没有恶性增殖的继续排得更高；整段读法两者都保持，代价是独立审查的判据 (b) 与 (c)。若 G0 的记入取逐步读法而 C 取整段读法，两者都保持，但 G0 与 C 不再共用一种 living 读法：形式上两者各以读法为参数，前提卡上 C 所说的“活的内容”却是 G0 的 living，分开取须公开。哪一种是生生的读法，由 Ren 选择。在二元定律族中，两种读法下 C 都把在阈值之前的节制排在过度汲取之上，所以那里逐步读法的代价是与不在场的比较，且只对在损失之前有被记入事件的形成；有第三个形成共用条件时，与节制的比较也可以失去（ThirdParty）。 / The two rankings part ways under the stepwise reading. If G0 and C share the stepwise reading, C still ranks sharing above winning by consumption but no longer ranks the continuation without malignant growth higher; the whole-run reading keeps both, at the cost of the independent review's criteria (b) and (c). If G0's credit takes the stepwise reading and C the whole-run reading, both are kept, but G0 and C no longer share one reading of living: formally each takes its reading as a parameter, while the premise card reads C's “living content” as G0's living, so a split must be disclosed. Which reading is the reading of 生生 is Ren's choice. In the two-part family C ranks restraint before the threshold above overdraw under both readings, so the cost of the stepwise reading there is the comparison with absence, and only for a formation with a credited event before the loss; with a third formation sharing the condition the comparison with restraint can be lost too (ThirdParty).

只在支持门控定律族（二元：焦点形成与维持者）与三对比较继续（在场／不在场、共享／以消耗取胜、停止／过度汲取）中证明；第三个形成的见证（ThirdParty）表明节制的结论不推广到多个共用者；关系层读法同样记入焦点形成的第一个关系，但未单独形式化；不推出责任、义务或可行性；不选择读法。 / Proved only in the support-gated family (two parts: the focal and the sustaining formation) and for three pairs of compared continuations (occurs/absent, sharing/winning, stops/overdraws); the third-party witness (ThirdParty) shows the restraint conclusion does not extend to several co-drawers; the relation-level reading also credits the focal formation's first relation but is not formalized separately; yields no responsibility, duty or feasibility; chooses no reading.
